mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month window) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in the equity market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a deepening recession (as indicated by industrial production below 100 index), a further decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during deepening recessions (INDPRO < 100) when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST below 800 thousand units) signals a depressed housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is below 800.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) signals disinflationary pressures that encourage the Federal Reserve to maintain low interest rates, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a severe economic downturn that the central bank is trying to combat, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS declines in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO below 105 index) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 105.
